object.script:
min_charge = 0.5 max_charge = 0.9
clutch = 0 clutch_step = 0.01
function onTick() charge = input.getNumber(1)
if charge < min_charge then clutch = math.min(clutch + clutch_step, 1) else if charge > max_charge then clutch = math.max(clutch - clutch_step, 0) end end
output.setNumber(1, clutch) end
